subject: Renewal planning: Nimbus Analytics upcoming renewal + usage dip
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal + note on reduced query volume

Hi Rafael,

Our renewal for the enterprise plan is scheduled for 2027-10-20. Over the last 60 days we've seen a ~28% drop in inference volume (see attached export), and procurement wants to understand whether usage-based billing or a fixed commit makes more sense for us going into the next year.

Can you share the renewal options and whether there are short-term credits or committed tiers you can recommend? Also need a quick sketch of how Redwood would handle sustained lower throughput without impacting SLAs.

I've attached our internal usage export (NIM-MAT-usage-report.xlsx). If easier, we can sync this week — Tue or Wed morning PT works for me.

Thanks,
Claire
Director of Data Platforms
Nimbus Analytics

[attachment: NIM-MAT-usage-report.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + note on reduced query volume

Claire — thanks for the note and the report. I reviewed the top-line drop and have a couple quick hypotheses (one is seasonal pipeline change; another is recent model latency tuning we pushed).

Short answers:
- We can offer a blended renewal that includes a smaller committed ARR floor + usage overage at a reduced per-token rate, which protects you against big month-to-month swings.
- For immediate relief we can provide a one-time transitional credit tied to usage levels for Q4 while you stabilize demand.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll pull a concise renewal proposal (SOW + pricing ladder) — sending draft by EOD Monday.
2) If that looks good, we’ll route to contracts and propose a DocuSign for a 12-month blended-commit.
3) Laura (cc) — can you flag finance here for runway impact and confirm whether we can provide a time-limited credit (up to 10% of projected first quarter ARR) as a standard concession?

Claire — you mentioned Tue/Wed mornings PT — I can do Wed 9:30 PT. Does that work?

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[attachment: SOW-Nimbus-Renewal-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-02T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + note on reduced query volume

Rafael / Claire — quick internal note and recommendation (looping Priyom for billing approval):

- Risk: 28% usage decline in the 60-day window is material and increases churn risk if the customer perceives overage costs or inability to scale down the commit.
- Recommended play: offer a 9-12 month blended commit (lower floor than last term) + 3-month usage credit tied to restoring baseline volume. The credit should require a simple attestation of intent to expand ROI workstreams (e.g., two check-ins + adoption plan).
- Finance ask for Priyom: can we structure the credit as an invoice-level credit (not a discount in list price) so ARR recognition remains straightforward? If yes, provide the template and I’ll include it in the SOW note.

Claire — if you’re comfortable we’ll draft the exact credit terms in the SOW and include a March 2028 re-eval clause to revisit commit levels. Rafael — please add the DocuSign link to the draft and share the HubSpot deal ID.

Laura
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + note on reduced query volume

Confirming finance position: we can structure a time-limited invoice credit up to 10% of the estimated Q1 ARR (as previously discussed) and will treat the remainder as standard commit for ARR recognition. Two compliance notes: the credit needs a signed SOW addendum and the credit period must be capped to 90 days.

I created the draft credit clause and uploaded it to the HubSpot deal (link below). Rafael — please confirm final numbers and mark the deal stage to "Commit - Contract Sent" in HubSpot once DocuSign is sent. Claire — if you want, Rafael and I can join Wed 9:30 PT to walk the SOW and credit language live.

Thanks,
Priyom
Revenue Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
